verdict.rationale: GitHub repo description explicitly states Bolna is an 'end-to-end open source production ready framework' for building voice AI apps, confirming the core engine's source is publicly available. However, no evidence specifies the actual license type (e.g., MIT/Apache) or confirms that the full platform (dashboard, MCP server, enterprise features) is open-sourced rather than just the core framework. Missing for 10: explicit license name/file, confirmation that all core product surfaces (not just the underlying framework) are open, independent corroboration of license terms.
